title: VenomLink: when nearby care is hard to reach
caption: Lahore · real Google map and routes · independent facility evidence
speech: A hospital marker tells us where a building is. It does not establish suitable care or reveal fragile access across a river. VenomLink connects geographic evidence, real driving estimates, and infrastructure scenarios in Lahore. This is a working hackathon prototype, shown through actual application screenshots.

title: Inspect the evidence behind each point
caption: 11 independent records served from private Amazon S3
speech: Each independent facility record has coordinates, source links, quality, and a retrieval timestamp. Flip a card to inspect the actual record, served through the deployed private S three data path. Treatment capability and antivenom stock remain unknown. A retrieval date does not mean clinical verification.

title: A hypothetical local upgrade changes access
caption: 20-minute model: 4/8 to 6/8 sampled communities
speech: The separate planning model uses explicit assumptions about distance, speed and access overhead. At twenty minutes, four of eight sample communities meet the baseline threshold. Making Shahdara Town T H Q eligible raises that to six. This is a hypothetical planning change, not a real treatment or stock claim.

title: One crossing. Different consequences.
caption: 30-minute model: 5/8 to 4/8 after a hypothetical crossing delay
speech: At thirty minutes, a hypothetical crossing delay reduces sampled access from five communities to four. Only crossing dependent journeys receive that delay. Closure removes those model connections without inventing a detour. These percentages count sample communities, not population. The scenarios do not change Google's reported road conditions.

title: AWS discovery preserves the coverage gap
caption: Real Amazon Location SearchText response · locality, not medical care
speech: Amazon Location Search Nearby and Search Text run through A W S Lambda. Hospital category searches returned no matches in our tests. An area search returned the actual Shahdara locality, clearly labeled as a geographic reference. Zero matches do not establish that hospitals are absent, and a locality is not medical care.

title: Clear service boundaries and real delivery
caption: API Gateway + Lambda + S3 + Amazon Location + Secrets Manager
speech: Python validation prepares independent public facts for private S three delivery. Provider discovery stays in an attributed, temporary list. Google geometry stays on Google Maps. The backend route credential is stored in Secrets Manager. Optional Iceberg and Athena scripts are included, but those analytics extensions are not deployed.

title: Real routes without activating paid Google billing
caption: Maps Demo Key · traffic-aware Compute Routes · on-demand comparisons
speech: The no billing Google Maps Demo Key renders the map and supports Compute Routes. The protected backend returns actual driving estimates and traffic speed intervals. An on demand comparison uses up to five supported route calls, avoiding the billing only matrix method. Provider limits can pause this prototype. Driving estimates are not ambulance response times.

title: A photograph must never delay finding care
caption: Illustrations and local preview · no trained classifier connected
speech: The optional photo helper contains labeled illustrations and a local image preview. No trained classifier is connected, and no identification is invented. VenomLink makes geographic access, its assumptions, and each point's evidence inspectable. Real healthcare partnerships and verified clinical data remain essential before any operational care use.
